title: Here's Ranma
overview: Soun Tendo gets quite a surprise when the son of his friend Genma Saotome that he's arranged for one of his daughters to marry turns out to be a girl...

title: School is No Place for Horsing Around
overview: Attending his first day at Furinkan High, Ranma encounters Akane's many would-be suitors.

title: A Sudden Storm of Love
overview: Not realizing that Ranma and 'the pigtailed girl' are the same, Kuno is furious that he let the "cretin" slip away. His attention soon shifts to the red-haired one though, when she bests him in combat.

title: Ranma and... Ranma? If It's Not One Thing, It's Another
overview: As Kuno continues his attempts to get a date with the 'pigtailed goddess', Ranma starts freaking out, while Nabiki smells money.

title: Love Me to the Bone! The Compound Fracture of Akane's Heart
overview: A solid beating from Akane brings Ranma to Dr. Tofu, who tries to help out the two teens' relationship, as well as Ranma's injuries.

title: Akane's Lost Love... These Things Happen, You Know
overview: Akane and Ranma are back at Dr. Tofu's when Kasumi shows up, causing Tofu to start acting like a loon out of love, something Akane doesn't handle well.

title: Enter Ryoga! The Eternal 'Lost Boy'
overview: After years of searching, Ryoga Hibiki finally finds the person who ruined his life - Ranma Saotome. Now, if only Ranma could remember what the heck he did to make Ryoga so mad...

title: School is a Battlefield! Ranma vs. Ryoga
overview: Ryoga finally manages to find Ranma again, and challenges him to a fight in the schoolyard. Unfortunately for Ranma, several outside parties have a vested interest in seeing him lose.

title: True Confessions! A Girl's Hair is Her Life!
overview: Akane's accidental haircut brings a temporary reprieve in Ranma and Ryoga's fighting. Stunned, she wanders off alone, thinking about the loss of the one thing that wasn't 'tomboyish' about her.

title: P-P-P-Chan! He's Good For Nothin'
overview: Not knowing that it's Ryoga, Akane adopts the little black pig as her pet, naming him P-Chan. This of course drives Ranma crazy, as he desperately wants to get Ryoga away from her, yet feels honorbound not to reveal the secret.

title: Ranma Meets Love Head-On! Enter the Delinquent Juvenile Gymnast!
overview: Intending to insure St. Hebereke School for Girls' victory in the upcoming match, Kodachi of puts the entire Furinkan Martial Arts Rythmic Gymnastics team out of commission. Akane is chosen as Furinkan's replacement, but not only does her gymnastics skills leave something to be desired, Kodachi decides to lessen Akane's odds with a little visit to the Tendo Dojo...

title: A Woman's Love is War! The Martial Arts Rhythmic Gymnastics Challenge!
overview: Akane twists her ankle during practice, forcing Ranma to take her place in the match with Kodachi.

title: A Tear in a Girl-Delinquent's Eye? The End of the Martial Arts Rhythmic Gymnastics Challenge!
overview: Ranma faces Kodachi in the ring, with the Black Rose's love on the line.

title: Pelvic Fortune-Telling? Ranma is the No. One Bride in Japan
overview: Dr. Tofu's mother comes to visit, determined to find her son a bride. Nabiki, Akane and Ranma all find themselves volunteering to help him get her of his back.

title: Enter Shampoo, the Gung-Ho Girl! I Put My Life in Your Hands
overview: Ranma gets a shock when an Amazon girl he encountered in China tracks him down, intending to kill his girl half.

title: Shampoo's Revenge! The Shiatsu Technique That Steals Heart and Soul
overview: Tired of the constant outbursts whenever she gets near Ranma, Shampoo decides to get Akane out of the way.

title: I Love You, Ranma! Please Don't Say Goodbye
overview: Ranma desperately attempts to recover Akane's lost memory. He even turns to Shampoo who promises to help... at a price.

title: I Am a Man! Ranma's Going Back to China!?
overview: Genma tries to dissuade Ranma from abandoning Akane to travel back to China and trying to find a cure at Jusenkyo.
